campaign: Verification integrity: tagged artifact lanes, clean source provenance, and live-plan hygiene
doctrine: Follow skill.md. docs/plan.json is the sole open-work authority; queue order is binding and plan complete means campaign complete.

items.title: Make model-verification source authority reproducible and repair the affected full-pipeline claims

steps.title: Refuse claims from dirty source trees and bind the Wan, LiveEdit, and Qwen3.5-9B records to commits containing their verifier implementations
steps.verify: go test ./cmd/compatibility ./internal/runrecord -run 'TestVerifyingCommitRequiresCleanWorktree|TestModelVerificationLedger' -count=1 && grep -q '"commit": "f7a336a2144789bb7c628182158b4364c0a039a2"' docs/verification/qwen35-9b-training.json && test $(grep -l '"commit": "4dd29342' docs/verification/{wan,liveedit}-training.json | wc -l) -eq 2

items.title: Delete campaign-local checkers that contradict the open-work-only plan contract

steps.title: Remove both completed-campaign scripts and retain plan-schema coverage in the owning Go packages
steps.verify: test ! -e scripts/check_video_campaign.py && test ! -e scripts/check_circuit_campaign.py && go test ./internal/plan ./cmd/plan -count=1
